summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, reporting amendments to short-term senior secured notes with Hollywood Horizons, Abri Capital, and Brown Stone Capital. The company outlined two 25% original issue discount notes totaling $1,066,666 in principal, yielding $800,000 in proceeds, with 1,000,000 commitment shares issued. An Omnibus Amendment removed 5,000,000 penalty default shares, reduced Abri's conversion to $66,666.70 principal at $0.10 per share, modified maturity and interest terms, and included a $150,000 arrangement fee to Brown Stone. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
